compatibility_contract.required_input_construction: Arithmetic mean of the nine deposited raw SIM phase frames for a BioSR v9 field; the actual stack depth is verified from the archive record.
compatibility_contract.machine_checkable_scope: Dimensionality, unit, spacing and analysis grid are checked at runtime. Acquisition identity and phase-mean construction remain user-declared outside the locked BioSR runner.

disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.hessian_blob_scale: Reference maxima were censored at the scale-grid boundary in development; retain the complete curve.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.hessian_tube_scale: Reference maxima were censored at the scale-grid boundary in development; retain the complete curve.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.spectral_scale: Failed the frozen v5 paired-acquisition tolerance; retain the calibrated spectrum without this scalar.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.variogram_horizontal_curve: Coordinate-dependent v5 definition removed; the intrinsic directional response is still separately developmental.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.variogram_vertical_curve: Coordinate-dependent v5 definition removed; the intrinsic directional response is still separately developmental.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.variogram_range_horizontal: Coordinate-dependent range scalar removed after v5 failure.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.variogram_range_vertical: Failed the prospective v5 gate and was removed rather than retuned.

limited_support_notes.tensor_orientation: Only seven ER development reference fields supported the consensus-gated orientation endpoint. The field-cluster bootstrap upper 95% risk was 12.99%; untouched confirmation is mandatory.
limited_support_notes.tensor_coherence: Development coverage was 86.52% overall and 72.81% in ER at 3.68% pooled risk. Untouched confirmation must preserve the fixed cutoff.
limited_support_notes.comparator: Component-correct conventional acquisition QC passed the development safety gate at slightly higher coverage. NOSTOS-specific incremental value remains unconfirmed.

unknown_profile_behavior: Measurements are returned as unvalidated unless a compatible acquisition profile or direct perturbation/ground-truth validation is available.
claim_boundary: A structure-independent development-calibrated BioSR profile awaiting untouched Microtubule and F-actin confirmation; not a universal, biological or clinical endorsement.
